name: Startup And System Config
summary: Startup lifecycle orchestration, coordinated application shutdown, a background Dunnage image-cache synchronization pass that mirrors the configured shared image folder into Assets/DunnageImages for local-first rendering, application and workstation defaults, software-version enforcement against MySQL, and system-level configuration models shared across the app.

validationHints: Confirm startup lifecycle and workstation defaults still initialize the app as expected
Confirm startup creates Assets/DunnageImages and starts the Dunnage image-cache sync without blocking the app shell
Confirm startup cancellation, lockout, and fatal-startup paths now shut the app down through the coordinated shutdown flow
Confirm startup seeds software_version when the table is empty and closes the app on version mismatch
Confirm the recurring version monitor closes the app after acknowledgment or timeout when the required version changes
